source.tabHint: t.0 (Build section extracted from full export)

screenGroups.title: Build Kickoff
screenGroups.goal: Carry the brief, storyboard, and rough screens into Build without another summary step.

screenGroups.title: Map Repo and Starter
screenGroups.goal: Anchor implementation to known file paths and startup flow.

screenGroups.title: Install MCPs and Skills
screenGroups.goal: Prepare design, browser, and provider tooling stack.

screenGroups.title: Wire DB/Auth/Payments
screenGroups.goal: Complete integration setup for auth, data, and checkout.

screenGroups.title: Switch to Sandbox and Boot Local
screenGroups.goal: Move testing to safe mode and verify local runtime.

screenGroups.title: Read and Execute AI Plans
screenGroups.goal: Convert giant plan output into a practical execution brief.

screenGroups.title: Build Core UX End-to-End
screenGroups.goal: Expand to complete core user path locally.

screenGroups.title: Debug and Stabilize
screenGroups.goal: Resolve blocker issues using evidence-first loops.

screenGroups.title: Finalize Build Handoff
screenGroups.goal: Assemble factual build summary and unlock Ship.

steps.title: Watch the Build kickoff
steps.action: Review the kickoff walkthrough and note the inputs Build inherits.
steps.definitionOfDone: Student understands the brief, storyboard, and rough-screen handoff.

steps.title: Move into repo mapping next
steps.action: Open the repo orientation lesson immediately after the kickoff.
steps.definitionOfDone: Build continues into real file mapping instead of another prep step.

steps.title: Map run scripts and package manager
steps.action: Identify startup scripts and package manager assumptions.
steps.definitionOfDone: Team can run app and name expected package manager.

steps.title: Map key files
steps.action: Locate env files, app entrypoints, and first target route.
steps.definitionOfDone: File map exists and is actionable.

steps.title: Install Figma and Playwright MCPs
steps.action: Set up design handoff and browser QA tooling.
steps.definitionOfDone: Both MCPs are callable in workflow.

steps.title: Confirm provider skills
steps.action: Ensure Convex, Clerk, and Stripe guidance is available.

steps.title: Set provider keys and auth template
steps.action: Configure env keys and Clerk JWT template for Convex.
steps.definitionOfDone: Auth and key setup pass checks.

steps.title: Create payment objects and webhook flow
steps.action: Create Stripe product/price and wire webhook path.
steps.definitionOfDone: Checkout objects and webhook config are saved.

steps.title: Switch to sandbox
steps.action: Move from live to sandbox test context and refresh webhook values.
steps.definitionOfDone: All payment tests run in sandbox mode.

steps.title: Boot local baseline
steps.action: Start local app and verify baseline route behavior.
steps.definitionOfDone: App runs locally with no startup blocker.

steps.title: Distill giant plan output
steps.action: Extract actionable phases from long generated plan.
steps.definitionOfDone: Plan phases are scoped and sequenced.

steps.title: Define execution guardrails
steps.action: Capture risks and stop conditions before coding.
steps.definitionOfDone: Execution rules and known risks are documented.

steps.title: Implement first slice
steps.action: Build one narrow slice from the saved brief.

steps.title: Expand to core UX
steps.action: Build full core path end-to-end from first slice baseline.
steps.definitionOfDone: Core path works locally start to finish.

steps.title: Run blocker-first debug loop
steps.action: Capture evidence, execute fix loops, and stabilize blockers.

steps.title: Assemble Build handoff
steps.action: Compile build plan, local baseline, core UX status, and blocker stability into summary.

troubleshooting.title: Stale app/session
troubleshooting.action: Stop services, restart services, rerun baseline path.

troubleshooting.title: Paid access not unlocked
troubleshooting.action: Re-check webhook, entitlement mapping, and provider linkage.

troubleshooting.title: Login still failing
troubleshooting.action: Re-check issuer and auth key alignment.
